title: India's defence exports just hit a record
sources: ThePrint, 1 Sep 2026 — India's defence exports rocket to Rs 38,424 cr in FY26, up 63%
Indian Defence News, 1 Sep 2026 — Rajnath Singh reviews DPSU performance
caption:
India just posted its biggest defence export year ever.

₹38,424 crore in FY26 — up 63% from the year before, and 56 times what India exported back in 2013-14. Nearly half of it came from private companies and startups, not just government-run defence firms.

On August 28, the government eased export rules further: licenses now valid for 3 years, covering almost every country. India now exports to over 80 countries, through 145 different firms.

This is real manufacturing and engineering demand — and it's growing fast.

Sources: ThePrint, PIB, Indian Defence News (1 Sep 2026)
